test1.ptxt: Check and Record DTC and Freeze Frame Data
Clear DTC and Freeze Frame Data

test2.ptxt: Based on the recorded DTC and freeze frame data, reproduce the problem symptom and check the DTCs again.

item.ptxt: If DTCs are output, refer to "DTC Chart ()".

If a CAN communication system malfunction code is output, troubleshoot and repair the CAN communication first. (see ) However, if DTC U0100/65, U0123/62, U0124/95 or U0126/63 is output, perform the ECU data monitor (momentary interruption) inspection first. (see )
If SST (TaSCAN) cannot communicate with the skid control computer (built into the actuator), inspect the CAN communication. (see )

If the ABS warning light and VSC warning light do not output DTCs, check that the warning lights illuminate during the initial check immediately after IG ON; if the lights do not illuminate, inspect the light circuit, and if they illuminate, inspect between the DLC3 connector TC terminal ←→ TC terminal of the engine control computer. (The TC terminal input is passed in the order DLC3 → engine control computer → CAN communication → skid control computer (built into the actuator))
If there is no response from the skid control computer (built into the actuator) by either SST (TaSCAN) or the multi-information display, inspect the actuator IG circuit.
